titleEn: CropX acquires SCIO to link agronomy with crop quality data
titleZh: CropX收购SCIO，将农艺管理与作物品质数据相连
summaryZh: 数字农艺公司CropX Technologies收购了便携式近红外光谱技术开发商SCIO，旨在将生长季的农艺建议与收获时的作物品质和成分测量数据连接起来，形成反馈闭环。SCIO的技术组合包括44项授权专利和不断增长的SaaS业务，其产品可应用于种子、谷物、油籽、饲料、牧草、浆果和甜玉米等。此次收购是CropX自2020年以来的第八次收购，其平台已在70多个国家使用。
featuredReason: 该收购展示了数字农业与传感器技术融合的趋势，对智慧畜牧行业在精准管理、数据闭环和品质追溯方面具有借鉴意义。
contentFull:
CropX acquires SCIO to link agronomy with crop quality data

 27-08 | Industry updates | Smart farming | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

SCIO is headquartered in the United States. Its products include the SCIO Mini and SCIO Cup portable crop analysis systems. Photo: CropX

Digital agronomy company CropX Technologies has acquired SCIO, a developer of portable near-infrared spectroscopy technology. The acquisition should enable CropX to connect agronomic recommendations during the growing season with measured crop quality and composition at harvest.

SCIO develops portable NIR spectroscopy systems that provide rapid, non-destructive measurements of crops and agricultural products. Applications include seed, grain and oilseeds, feed and forage, berries and sweet corn.

By integrating this technology, CropX aims to create a feedback loop between field management and actual harvest results. Data on crop quality and composition can be linked with CropX data from soil sensors, weather, satellite imagery and agronomic models. According to CropX, this should help improve future agronomic recommendations.

Eighth acquisition since 2020

SCIO’s technology portfolio includes 44 granted patents and a growing software-as-a-service business. The acquisition also gives CropX access to SCIO’s existing enterprise customers. Financial details of the transaction were not disclosed.

This is CropX’s eighth acquisition since 2020. The company says it has raised $64 million (€55 million) since its foundation and its digital agronomy platform is currently used in more than 70 countries.

translationZh:
数字农艺公司CropX Technologies已收购SCIO，后者是便携式近红外光谱技术的开发商。此次收购将使CropX能够将生长季的农艺建议与收获时测得的作物品质和成分数据连接起来。

SCIO开发便携式近红外光谱系统，可对作物和农产品进行快速、无损的测量。应用领域包括种子、谷物和油籽、饲料和牧草、浆果和甜玉米。

通过整合这项技术，CropX旨在建立田间管理与实际收获结果之间的反馈循环。作物品质和成分数据可以与CropX来自土壤传感器、天气、卫星图像和农艺模型的数据相关联。据CropX称，这将有助于改进未来的农艺建议。

**自2020年以来的第八次收购**

SCIO的技术组合包括44项授权专利和不断增长的软件即服务业务。此次收购还使CropX能够接触SCIO现有的企业客户。交易的财务细节未披露。

这是CropX自2020年以来的第八次收购。该公司表示，自成立以来已筹集了6400万美元（5500万欧元），其数字农艺平台目前已在70多个国家使用。
